hook: Stack thirds into major, minor, diminished and augmented chords on a keyboard, line up progressions like I-V-vi-IV, then train your ear: did that phrase come home?
outcome: Build triads from stacked thirds, name the chords of a major key with Roman numerals, and hear how tonic, predominant and dominant chords create rest and tension
